finalText:
Migration's done. All 11 files still on the old call now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`, matching the pattern already used elsewhere.

One file was left alone on purpose: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` is a vendored copy, marked "do not edit, replaced wholesale on every upgrade." Editing it would just get overwritten.

Also worth knowing: several files call `cache.query(...)` too. That's a separate cache module, not the database, so it's unrelated to this migration.
